title: Chef John's Fresh Tomato Sauce
description: Tomato sauce made from fresh tomatoes is a delicious and simple way to put vine-ripened summer tomatoes to good use and it tastes way better the jarred stuff.
ingredients: 5 pounds vine-ripened tomatoes, seeded and quartered
1 teaspoon kosher salt, or to taste

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat and add sliced garlic. Cook and stir for about 30 seconds before adding basil leaves. Sizzle garlic and basil in olive oil until the thinnest slices of garlic just start to turn golden. Quickly transfer in tomatoes. Add salt and pepper flakes (if using) and increase heat to medium-high.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until the mixture simmers and the tomatoes have completely collapsed and liquefied. Turn off the heat.
Using a strainer or colander, strain the sauce into another pot, pressing everything through with the back of a ladle or spatula, until nothing is left in the colander except the skins and seeds.
Place strained sauce back over medium heat and reduce to about 5 cups, or until desired thickness. Taste for seasoning and use immediately, or store in an airtight container until needed.

video.description: Try this recipe for a fresh and delicious sauce that you won’t get from the grocery store. In this video, Chef John demonstrates how to make a delicious fresh garden tomato sauce using ripe, meaty tomatoes straight from the garden. This sauce requires tomatoes that are fresh and sweet. After cutting and quartering the tomatoes, add them to a pot with olive oil, basil leaves, and sizzled garlic cloves. After letting them liquify, strain out the seeds and skin before adding it back to the heat to acquire the desired thickness. This flavorful homemade sauce works wonders for any Italian dinner or pasta dish.
